Validate model/field/span/alias ownership through checker and sealed IR. Reuse existing data cursor/query and grants-before-comparison path without new carrier. criteria.native_callable_cursor: Keep the original callable and extend canonical cursor pages to support it through a source-owned stable predicate/context identity and dependencies, reusing current source observation where possible. Preserves general authored expression behavior, but adds callable cursor support, binding/invalidation rules and associated validation beyond this one bool field.
